def: AI2's fully open post-training recipe and model family (2024), built on Llama 3.1 base models with SFT, DPO and RLVR, released with data, code and evaluations.
practice: A widely cited open reference for modern post-training and the report that named RLVR; the recipe was reused for OLMo 2 and SmolLM models.
